ccb-dxo-pureraw.name: ccb: Edit in DxO PureRAW
ccb-dxo-pureraw.notes: First public release, for macOS only. File ▸ Plug-ins ▸ ccb: Edit in DxO PureRAW ▸ Send Selected Photos sends raw photos to DxO PureRAW, and adds each DNG it makes to the library.
